title: Entity growth batch 03 — group B
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #199. Canonical publication prohibited until candidate validation and manual review complete.

entities.summary: Non-custodial multichain wallet ecosystem from Coin98, distributed across mobile and browser-extension surfaces.
entities.notes: Current first-party Coin98 documentation and terms explicitly describe Coin98 as non-custodial. Initial wallet launch date remains unresolved in this breadth pass.

entities.summary: Multichain Web3 wallet ecosystem distributed as mobile applications and browser wallet software.
entities.notes: Current first-party site establishes active MathWallet mobile/browser distribution. Reviewed security guidance treats mnemonic/private-key material as user-held secrets, but this candidate keeps custody_model unknown until a stronger current first-party custody statement is attached.

entities.summary: Self-custodial EVM wallet ecosystem from Ambire, currently centered on its browser extension with EOA and smart-account capabilities.
entities.notes: Ambire's current first-party material repeatedly describes Ambire Wallet and its extension as self-custodial. The older web-wallet lineage predates the current extension, so entity launch remains unresolved here.

entities.summary: Non-custodial multichain wallet ecosystem formerly branded XDEFI Wallet and rebranded to Ctrl Wallet in 2024.
entities.notes: First-party rebrand material explicitly states XDEFI users automatically update to Ctrl and retain locally stored keys, preserving one wallet lineage. Initial XDEFI launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Open-source non-custodial multichain Web3 browser wallet built by the team behind MyEtherWallet.
entities.notes: Enkrypt is modeled as a distinct wallet/project identity despite being built by the MEW team because it is separately branded, distributed and maintained as a multichain browser wallet. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current Coin98 non-custodial mobile wallet for multichain assets and Web3 access.
products.notes: Selected mobile boundary only. Coin98 Extension is a separate browser runtime and is deferred. Exact mobile launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current MathWallet mobile wallet application for multichain Web3 use on iOS and Android.
products.notes: Selected mobile boundary only; browser wallet is deferred. Custody remains unknown pending stronger current first-party terms rather than being inferred from security guidance alone.

products.summary: Current self-custodial Ambire Wallet browser extension supporting EOAs, smart accounts and hardware-wallet signers.
products.notes: First-party launch announcement states the extension became publicly available without invite codes on 2025-05-08. Older Ambire Web Wallet remains separate historical product lineage.

products.summary: Current Ctrl non-custodial browser wallet extension, continuing the former XDEFI Wallet extension lineage.
products.notes: Selected extension boundary only; Ctrl mobile apps are deferred. The 2024 rebrand is not treated as initial extension launch.

products.summary: Enkrypt non-custodial open-source multichain browser-extension wallet.
products.notes: Current first-party Enkrypt site explicitly distributes the extension across multiple browsers. Exact initial extension release date remains unresolved.

evidence.title: Coin98 Super Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party documentation describes Coin98 as a non-custodial multichain wallet ecosystem.

evidence.title: Coin98 Super Wallet Mobile
evidence.notes: First-party mobile documentation establishes the current non-custodial mobile wallet product.

evidence.title: Math Wallet, The Multichain Wallet for Web3
evidence.notes: Current first-party site establishes active MathWallet mobile and browser wallet distribution across many public chains.

evidence.title: Security Guide of Math Wallet
evidence.notes: Official security guidance establishes user-held mnemonic/private-key backup workflows but does not by itself justify a stronger current provider-custody claim, so custody remains unknown.

evidence.title: How To Make The Most Out Of Ambire Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Ambire article explicitly describes Ambire as a self-custodial Web3 wallet.

evidence.title: The Ambire Extension Launches Officially
evidence.notes: First-party announcement establishes the public Ambire Extension launch on 2025-05-08 and its self-custody mission.

evidence.title: XDEFI Wallet is becoming Ctrl Wallet: discover the new features
evidence.notes: First-party rebrand announcement explicitly establishes XDEFI→Ctrl continuity and states existing wallets automatically update while keys remain locally stored.

evidence.title: Ctrl Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site states Ctrl is non-custodial and confirms migration of the former XDEFI browser extension to Ctrl.

evidence.title: About Enkrypt
evidence.notes: First-party Enkrypt page identifies Enkrypt as a distinct multichain, non-custodial, open-source Web3 browser wallet built by the MEW team.

evidence.title: Enkrypt: Ethereum, Polkadot and Bitcoin Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site explicitly distributes Enkrypt as a non-custodial browser extension for Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Edge, Opera and Safari.
